headline: Kazakhstan Rail Logistics Handle 84% of China-Central Asia Trade Volume
summary: Kazakhstan handles approximately 84% of overland freight moved between China and Central Asia. Total bilateral trade between China and Central Asian nations reached nearly $70 billion in 2025, up from $23.5 billion in 2020.
why: Kazakhstan is a major transcontinental transit corridor connecting East Asian industrial hubs with Middle Eastern and European trade routes.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Expanded regional freight volumes bolster transport logistics revenue and trade integration.
